title: the halfling deity prose
audit_comment: THE HALFLING DEITY PROSE - part 3 of the Appendix S description-paragraph close. The archive.org full-text OCR of pp. 116-118 reads the four halfling blocks scan-clean: the Sheela festivals and the entangle craft, the Arvoreen unseen summons of halfling heroes, the Cyrrollalee furniture animation and home trust, and the Brandobaris dust sling, escape dagger, and reward risks. The stat-block numerics stay R406/R783; the paragraph facts ride rules/uadeityprose3.h.

banner.provenance: Part 3 of the five-part close (R786 the dwarves, R787 the elves). The four halfling blocks (pp. 116-118) read scan-clean in the archive.org full-text OCR: every pin below is the printed text. The stat-block numerics stay R406/R783; the paragraph-level facts pin here - the Sheela entangle craft and the quest grant, the Arvoreen reflection and the hero summons, the Cyrrollalee furniture gift and the service debt, and the Brandobaris dust-ball sleep and the daring reward. Parts 4-5 remain: the gnomes and the orcs.

consts.name: udp3ProseRound
consts.comment: The prose round: part 3, the halfling paragraphs

consts.name: udp3StatblockFeederRound
consts.comment: The feeder round: the R406 stat blocks these paragraphs hang under

consts.name: udp3HalflingDeityCount
consts.comment: The halfling census: four blocks described (Sheela, Arvoreen, Cyrrollalee, Brandobaris)

consts.name: udp3PantheonWorshipMin
consts.comment: Most communities worship only a few deities, four or five at most: the minimum four

consts.name: udp3PantheonWorshipMax
consts.comment: and the maximum five

consts.name: udp3GreaterDeityCount
consts.comment: The pantheon has one greater deity only (Yondalla)

consts.name: udp3SheMajorCelebrations
consts.comment: Two major celebrations are held yearly aside from the regular monthly services

consts.name: udp3SheFestivalAvgDays
consts.comment: The festival length varies by area, averaging about 10 days

consts.name: udp3SheEntangleGrantPct
consts.comment: A 1 percent chance that a great quest or sacrifice wins the entangle grant

consts.name: udp3SheEntangleLevel
consts.comment: The granted entangle casts at the 6th level of ability

consts.name: udp3SheNeutralEntangleLevel
consts.comment: True neutral halflings cast the granted entangle at 12th level of ability

consts.name: udp3SheStaffBonus
consts.comment: Her shillelagh-like staff from a blade of grass or twig is +4 to hit

consts.name: udp3SheStaffDamageMin
consts.comment: The staff does 2-16 points of damage plus strength: the minimum 2

consts.name: udp3SheStaffDamageMax
consts.comment: and the maximum 16

consts.name: udp3SheStaffCraftSegments
consts.comment: She creates the staff in one segment

consts.name: udp3SheEntanglePerRound
consts.comment: She can cast entangle once per round as often as she likes

consts.name: udp3SheDoubleCastSpeedDiv
consts.comment: Two failed saves against her entangle slow a troll to one-fourth normal speed

consts.name: udp3SheSuccessiveDamageMin
consts.comment: Each successive entangle after the first inflicts 1-4 points of constriction damage: the minimum 1

consts.name: udp3SheSuccessiveDamageMax
consts.comment: and the maximum 4

consts.name: udp3ArvFirstAttackDamageDiv
consts.comment: The first attack upon Arvoreen (if it hits) does only half damage, regardless of power

consts.name: udp3ArvUnseenRoundsMin
consts.comment: He can attack unseen for the first 4-16 rounds of combat: the minimum 4

consts.name: udp3ArvUnseenRoundsMax
consts.comment: and the maximum 16

consts.name: udp3ArvSwordBonus
consts.comment: He uses a +4 sword that shapechanges into any hand-to-hand weapon he desires

consts.name: udp3ArvSummonPerDay
consts.comment: Once a day Arvoreen may summon halfling fighters

consts.name: udp3ArvSummonMin
consts.comment: The summon brings 10-40 halfling fighters: the minimum 10

consts.name: udp3ArvSummonMax
consts.comment: and the maximum 40

consts.name: udp3ArvSummonHeroLevel
consts.comment: Each summoned fighter is a 4th-level Hero

consts.name: udp3ArvSummonAc
consts.comment: The summoned heroes are AC 4

consts.name: udp3ArvSummonHp
consts.comment: and each has 25 hit points

consts.name: udp3CyrAnimateRadiusInches
consts.comment: She animates all non-living objects within a radius of 6 inches of her

consts.name: udp3CyrAnimateClericLevel
consts.comment: The animation works as if by a 20th-level cleric

consts.name: udp3CyrAnimateVolumeMax
consts.comment: Up to 20 cubic feet of material

consts.name: udp3CyrAnimateRounds
consts.comment: for 20 rounds

consts.name: udp3CyrAnimatePerDay
consts.comment: She can perform this power up to three times a day

consts.name: udp3CyrFurnitureChancePct
consts.comment: A 2 percent chance that a faithful follower calling from home gains the furniture gift

consts.name: udp3CyrFurnitureVolumeMax
consts.comment: One piece of furniture not larger than 5 cubic feet in volume

consts.name: udp3CyrFurnitureRounds
consts.comment: animated for 5 rounds

consts.name: udp3CyrFurnitureAttacksPerRound
consts.comment: attacking all enemies of that halfling once per round

consts.name: udp3CyrGiftLifetimeMax
consts.comment: The gift may be given to a halfling character only twice in his or her lifetime

consts.name: udp3CyrServiceDayOfMonth
consts.comment: Worship services are held on the first day of each month

consts.name: udp3BraDaggerBonus
consts.comment: He carries a dagger +3 he wields when combat cannot be avoided

consts.name: udp3BraSlingBonus
consts.comment: He also uses a +4 sling that hurls a ball of dust

consts.name: udp3BraDustRangeMaxInches
consts.comment: The dust ball has a maximum range of 48 inches

consts.name: udp3BraDustRangeShortInches
consts.comment: with 24 inches short range

consts.name: udp3BraDustRangeMediumInches
consts.comment: and 36 inches medium range

consts.name: udp3BraDustSaveMod
consts.comment: The victim must save versus spell at -6

consts.name: udp3BraSleepTurnsMin
consts.comment: or fall deeply asleep for 6-36 turns: the minimum 6

consts.name: udp3BraSleepTurnsMax
consts.comment: and the maximum 36

consts.name: udp3BraRewardChancePct
consts.comment: A 5 percent chance his reward goes to any halfling of 10th level or lower

consts.name: udp3BraRewardLevelMax
consts.comment: The reward-eligible halfling is of 10th level or lower

consts.name: udp3BraRewardLifetimeMax
consts.comment: He rewards such daring only once in that halfling lifetime

consts.name: udp3BraMeetChancePctPerLevel
consts.comment: A 1 percent chance per level that a high-level thief actually meets him

consts.name: udp3BraMeetLevelMin
consts.comment: The meeting chance applies to a halfling thief of 11th level or higher

bools.name: udp3PantheonOnlyGoodPowers
bools.comment: The halflings have no deities of evil nature, or of war, suffering, fire and water, or death

bools.name: udp3YondallaTopAuthority
bools.comment: Yondalla is the top authority among the halfling gods, though her control over Brandobaris is minimal at times

bools.name: udp3YondallaFuneralProtector
bools.comment: Yondalla is usually invoked at funerals as a protector of the departed souls of halflings

bools.name: udp3FemaleDeitiesStronger
bools.comment: The more powerful halfling deities tend to be females, by contrast with the dwarven males

bools.name: udp3GreenFieldsOnSevenHeavens
bools.comment: Most of the pantheon resides on the Seven Heavens in an area known as the Green Fields

bools.name: udp3PantheonSheelaConcordant
bools.comment: Sheela Peryroyl and one or two other deities make their homes on the plane of Concordant Opposition

bools.name: udp3PantheonBrandobarisRoams
bools.comment: Brandobaris roams the Prime Material Plane

bools.name: udp3UrogalanNeutralEarthGod
bools.comment: The neutral-aligned masculine lesser deity Urogalan is primarily an earth god

bools.name: udp3UrogalanJudgesDead
bools.comment: Urogalan sometimes acts as a judge of and protector of the dead

bools.name: udp3UrogalanOnConcordant
bools.comment: Urogalan lives on the plane of Concordant Opposition

bools.name: udp3PantheonPledgedTogether
bools.comment: All the halfling deities are pledged to work together against the enemies of the halfling people

bools.name: udp3SheFlowerDressed
bools.comment: Her appearance is that of a halfling female dressed in wildflowers

bools.name: udp3SheFieldsGrowWhenSings
bools.comment: When she sings she causes fields to grow, trees to bud, and seeds to sprout

bools.name: udp3SheWeatherToFaithful
bools.comment: She brings good weather to her favored worshipers

bools.name: udp3SheDroughtFloodsToPoorly
bools.comment: But she can easily send drought or floods to those who worship her poorly

bools.name: udp3SheFollowersWearFlower
bools.comment: Her followers often wear a small flower in her honor

bools.name: udp3SheFollowersWorkHarmony
bools.comment: Her followers strive to work in harmony with nature and the earth

bools.name: udp3SheSeedingFestival
bools.comment: The planting celebration is called The Seeding or New Spring depending on the region

bools.name: udp3SheHighHarvestFestival
bools.comment: The harvest celebration is called High Harvest or The Reaping

bools.name: udp3SheRevelryAtFestivals
bools.comment: Community-wide revelry is common at the celebrations, from evening into late night

bools.name: udp3SheQuestsGrowHarder
bools.comment: The quests or sacrifices to regain the entangle grant become harder and more costly as time goes on

bools.name: udp3SheOneEntangleAtATime
bools.comment: Only one such entangle spell may be had at any one time

bools.name: udp3SheEntangleCumulative
bools.comment: Her entangle effects are cumulative if cast several times over the same area

bools.name: udp3SheConstrictionNoSave
bools.comment: The successive-entangle constriction damage allows no saving throw and hits movers and non-movers alike

bools.name: udp3ArvNeverAttacksFirst
bools.comment: Arvoreen never attacks an opponent first

bools.name: udp3ArvFirstMagicReflected
bools.comment: The first magical attack upon him is automatically reflected back upon the caster

bools.name: udp3ArvInvisibleAtWill
bools.comment: He can go invisible at will

bools.name: udp3ArvOnlyFightsIfAttacked
bools.comment: He will only engage in combat if he is attacked, though he seeks his enemies and actively confronts them

bools.name: udp3ArvFightsToFinish
bools.comment: He will not go far out of his way to avoid combat, and will fight to the finish

bools.name: udp3ArvThievingAgainstEnemies
bools.comment: Thieving skills employed against enemies to better later combat are permissible to him

bools.name: udp3ArvNoStealingFromHalflings
bools.comment: He absolutely forbids stealing from other halflings or allied beings

bools.name: udp3ArvHeroesObeyImplicitly
bools.comment: The summoned heroes will obey him implicitly

bools.name: udp3ArvHeroesSwordAndBow
bools.comment: Each summoned hero is armed with short sword and short bow

bools.name: udp3ArvPatronOfFighters
bools.comment: He is the patron of halfling fighters, the closest thing the halflings have to a god of war

bools.name: udp3CyrDeityOfFriendship
bools.comment: Cyrrollalee is the deity of friendship and trust, and a protector like Yondalla

bools.name: udp3CyrHomeProtectorOpenDwelling
bools.comment: She protects the home but keeps the inhabitants from being too defensive and closed in

bools.name: udp3CyrPeasantAppearance
bools.comment: She appears a normal female halfling with brown hair in simple peasant clothing

bools.name: udp3CyrEnemyOfTrustBreakers
bools.comment: Her worst enemies are those who betray the trust of a host, break into halfling homes to steal, or break oaths

bools.name: udp3CyrAnimationPersists
bools.comment: The animation effects continue even if Cyrrollalee leaves the area

bools.name: udp3CyrGiftRequiresService
bools.comment: Any halfling receiving the furniture gift is obligated to perform a challenging but not exceptionally difficult service afterward

bools.name: udp3CyrAnyFighterWeapon
bools.comment: No particular weapons are associated with her, but she can use any weapon a regular fighter could

bools.name: udp3CyrFollowersPlainHomes
bools.comment: Her followers are largely regular halflings (0-level characters) and some fighter types

bools.name: udp3BraSilenceUnhearable
bools.comment: He moves so silently that no mortal being or god can hear him if he desires concealment

bools.name: udp3BraHidesExceptTrueSeeing
bools.comment: He can hide so well as to be completely invisible, detectable only with a true seeing spell or similar item

bools.name: udp3BraDaggerPointsEscape
bools.comment: His dagger magically points out the fastest and safest direction of escape from any maze or trap

bools.name: udp3BraMazeImmuneWithDagger
bools.comment: He is immune to maze spells when holding his dagger

bools.name: udp3BraDustBallHarmless
bools.comment: The dust ball does not harm the victim it strikes

bools.name: udp3BraTricksterRascal
bools.comment: He is primarily a clever thief who fools opponents into thinking him harmless, then steals them blind and escapes their wrath

bools.name: udp3BraMeetsAsFellowThief
bools.comment: He meets high-level thieves in the guise of another halfling thief and invites them on a thieving adventure

bools.name: udp3BraIdentityOnlyAfter
bools.comment: He reveals his identity only after the adventure is over

bools.name: udp3BraIdentityOnlyToFollowers
bools.comment: and only to his followers

bools.name: udp3BraNonWorshippersLoseItems
bools.comment: Non-worshipping companions might find some of their valuables missing when the adventure is over
